 New daily dialogues
Dating dialogues
Sweet & Spicy Marriage Dialogue
Festival dialogues (dating + marriage ver.)

Extra event sprites

[*][b]You will ONLY need[/b] [b]SMAPI, Content Patcher, and  Portraiture[/b] to make this mod function. Other listed requirements are [u]optional but recommended[/u]. 




[center][size=4]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/Vi4layx.gif[/img] [b] [/b][color=#C91C3A][font=Comic Sans MS][b]About the Story[/b] [/font] [/color][img]https://i.imgur.com/Vi4layx.gif[/img][/size][/center]

This is a bittersweet mutual love story about a lonely vampire who meets the light of his life. 
The affection will build up slowly as you get closer to this cool hoodie guy.  His personality keep the vanilla Sebastian, but you'll notice his vampiric nature influence him. 

[list]
[*][color=#b4a7d6][b][font=Comic Sans MS]Before marriage[/font][/b]:[/color] Tender, innocent romance with a slow build-up. [/*]
[*][b][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#ea9999]After marriage[/color][/font][/b]: Deeper emotions, more intense storylines, and optional [i]spicy [/i]content.[/*]
[/list]
The main storyline will end at 14 hearts. Once you complete all VS events, you’ll unlock a whole set of new, obsessive post-marriage dialogues and some extra events!

[center][/center]
[center]

[color=#e69138][b]△△ Caution
[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2544?tab=files&file_id=127424]Canon-Friendly Dialogue Expansion[/url]﻿ / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7948]True Love valley[/url]﻿, make sure you turn OFF Sebastian's dialogue in config menu, or they'll overwrite this mod[/*]

[/list][b]
[color=#e06666]XX Bah bah[/color]
[/b]

[*][b]Not compatible[/b] with other major Sebastian expansion mods.[/*]

[/list]
[i]This mod also adds a few lines for other villagers after you married Sebastian. ( Wizard, Robin, Sam... etc.)[/i]

If you really want compatibility with another mod, contact me — I’ll consider making a patch!

[font=Comic Sans MS][size=4][b][u]Feedback Welcome![/u][/b][/size][/font][/center]

This is my first mod, and it took me over a year to finish solely on my own. Your feedback matters a lot to me!! I’m  always open to feedback, ideas, or suggestions !!

English isn’t my first language, so there might be a few odd sentences here and there. I spent a month writing the English version and did my best, but if you spot anything that sounds off, please let me know. I’d love to improve it!

I’m in the western US time zone and check Nexus regularly, so feel free to reach out anytime.

Downloads.Description:
After downloading, place all three PNG images into the Portraiture folder.

The correct installation path should look like this: "Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\(the folder you created)"
If your PC has trouble opening the WinRAR portrait file above, please try downloading this ZIP version instead.

Extract this into your Mods folder. Don’t forget to download the portraits below!

All major bugs should be fixed by now. I will be focus on updating new content and there will be no hotfix unless any major bug appear. Enjoy!
